versions.changelog:
Initial release of entur-travel

- Plan public transit trips anywhere in Norway using the Entur API.
- Supports all transit modes and operators (bus, rail, tram, metro, ferry, coach, air).
- Command-line interface: search places/stops, plan trips (with optional timing/filters), view departures, and check stop details.
- Real-time transit info included.
- No API key required; free and open.
- JSON output for all commands.
